title: Light Mexican Amazake Wrap
description: A halal-friendly, festive mexican dish featuring amazake and a light, umami flavor profile, perfect for a quick breakfast or snack

ingredients.name: Amazake
ingredients.notes: made from fermented rice, a sweet and savory paste

ingredients.name: Spinach
ingredients.notes: fresh or frozen, thawed before using

instructions: Preheat a dry non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Brush a large tortilla with avocado oil on both sides.
Place the tortilla in the skillet and cook for 30 seconds on each side, until lightly toasted.
In a medium bowl, whisk together amazake, lime juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add shredded chicken, spinach, and red onion to the bowl and toss to combine.
Spoon the chicken mixture onto the center of the tortilla, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle cilantro over the top of the filling.
Fold the bottom edge of the tortilla up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make additional wraps.
